lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the fifth gill slit, with a high concentration of centroids localized between the primary lateral carina and the pectoral fin insertion.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a visible grid-like coordinate system of high-luminance nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal feature running from the dorsal margin of the gills toward the caudal region, defined by a significant luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the superior surface and low-intensity shadow on the inferior surface.
